modifiers: diagonal slash from top-left to bottom-right
depiction.composition: centered circular arrows crossed out by a diagonal line

readings.meaning: sync disabled, offline, or out of sync

ambiguity: Can be read either as a technical sync failure/off state or as canceling a recurring cycle like a subscription auto-renewal; at tiny sizes it may look like a generic prohibition sign.

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts circular sync/repeat arrows crossed out by a slash, universally understood as 'sync off / broken sync' or 'do not auto-renew / stop recurring cycle'. It fits common everyday tasks like canceling subscription auto-renewals, stopping autoship orders, disabling cloud sync, and fixing sync failures, though it can be confused with plain sync arrows at very small sizes.
